text: TIMEBOX-RELEASED by worker-2 after deep but incomplete investigation (heft, clang-20 build - NOTE: gcc-14 cannot even build these suites: the suite CMakeLists pass the clang-only flag -Wno-error=implicit-int-conversion which gcc rejects; build with -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang, or fix the CMakeLists to guard clang-only flags via check_c_compiler_flag - v1bd-family). EMPIRICAL STATE: (1) schc_rule1 profile-limit failure root-caused to lichen_schc_compress entry pre-filter in lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc.c:535 ('if (pkt_len > SCHC_FRAGMENT_MAX_PACKET_SIZE) return SCHC_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL') - it rejects on RAW packet size, but compression SHRINKS packets: test_profile_limit builds a raw 22569-byte packet that compresses to exactly the 22554 limit (37 fixed + raw tail); the per-rule checks ('37u + tail_len > SCHC_FRAGMENT_MAX_PACKET_SIZE' at schc_compress.c:120 etc.) are the correct compressed-size gate, so the entry pre-filter is over-broad and should be removed (or narrowed to the uncompressed-fallback path only; per-rule O(1) checks + out_len bounds keep everything fail-closed). Introduced by 660b9bf3bf lineage. (2) rule5/rule6 corrupt-checksum: expected SCHC_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT (-6), actual SCHC_ERR_NO_MATCHING_RULE (-1). Instrumented trace: the corrupted packet reaches lichen_rule_compress_oscore (schc.c:415), coap_has_oscore_option PASSES (option present), but compress_coap returns -1 (NO_MATCHING_RULE) from compress_link_local_coap_v3's SELECTOR checks - yet the identical packet with the checksum byte restored compresses fine (ret=24), so a UDP-checksum byte is somehow influencing selector matching. Trace with prints inside compress_link_local_coap_v3's selector block (src/dst/port/TKL/NULL-checks) to find which selector misfires on the corrupted byte - packet[46] is the UDP checksum high byte, which should not be selector-visible. (3) rule2/3/4 profile-limit failures share the rule1 shape. Debug instrumentation used was reverted; no code changes committed this round.
